result.instructions: Tools for Stiply, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents are still waiting for a signature?"; "Show me who has not signed the rental agreement yet and send them a reminder."; "List all sign requests that were rejected this month and the reason.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stiply data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stiply_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stiply_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stiply_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. stiply_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stiply_list_sign_requests
tools.title: List sign requests
tools.description: List sign requests (documents sent for e-signing) with status, title, sent/expiry/signed timestamps. Filter by status (draft, published, all_signed, completed, rejected, canceled, expired, ...). Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. published, completed, rejected, canceled, expired.

tools.name: stiply_get_sign_request
tools.title: Get a sign request
tools.description: Get one sign request by id: status, timestamps, message, reject reason, owner. Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests/{id}.

tools.name: stiply_get_sign_request_by_external_key
tools.title: Get a sign request by external key
tools.description: Find a sign request by the external_key set when it was created. Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests/by_key/{external_key}.

external_key.description: The external key given at creation.

annotations.title: Get a sign request by external key

tools.name: stiply_get_sign_request_progress
tools.title: Get sign request progress
tools.description: Get the audit trail of a sign request: each action (sent, opened, signed, ...) with time, IP, location and email status. Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests/{id}/progress.

tools.name: stiply_list_signers
tools.title: List signers
tools.description: List the signers of a sign request with email, name, role (signer/approver/cc/dc), authentication method and sign URL. Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests/{id}/signers.

tools.name: stiply_list_documents
tools.title: List documents of a sign request
tools.description: List the documents attached to a sign request (metadata only, no file download). Stiply API: GET /v2/sign_requests/{id}/documents.

annotations.title: List documents of a sign request

tools.name: stiply_create_sign_request
tools.title: Create and send a sign request
tools.description: WRITE: create a sign request and SEND it. Stiply downloads each PDF from file_urls and emails the signers at once, so confirm the signers with the user first. Stiply API: POST /v2/sign_requests.

file_urls.description: Public https URLs of the PDF documents to sign.

allow_add_fields.description: Let the signer place signature fields by clicking. Role signer only. Use this OR fields.

fields.description: Fields for this signer. A signer needs a signature field unless allow_add_fields is true.

name.description: Tag name: every {{name}} in the documents becomes the field.

message.description:
Email message. Basic HTML only; use
for newlines.

term.description: How long signers have, e.g. 1d, 2w, 3m. Default: the account setting.

external_key.description: Your own unique key to find this request later.

annotations.title: Create and send a sign request

tools.name: stiply_send_reminder
tools.title: Send a reminder
tools.description: WRITE: email a reminder to the signers who have not signed yet. Stiply API: POST /v2/sign_requests/{id}/actions/send_reminder.

tools.name: stiply_extend_term
tools.title: Extend the term
tools.description: WRITE: extend the signing term of a sign request. Stiply API: POST /v2/sign_requests/{id}/actions/extend_term.

tools.name: stiply_cancel_sign_request
tools.title: Cancel a sign request
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a sign request. This cannot be undone. Stiply API: POST /v2/sign_requests/{id}/actions/cancel.

notify_signers.description: Whether the signers get a cancellation email.

cancellation_message.description: Optional message shown to the signers.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Stiply
prompts.description: What you can do with Stiply here, with example requests to try.
